card_scores.rationale: Direct syntax, ordinary transitions, focused paragraphs, brief qualifications, and concise restatement consistently support a plain expository register, but the cues are highly generic.
Opposing-concern framing, explicit personal limitations, evidential grading, parallel categories, and restrained progression form a coherent cautious analytical register.
High-commitment theses, bounded concessions, purpose-specific criticism, corrective reframing, and numbered consequences strongly reinforce a precise critical-rebuttal register.
Guiding questions, parallel categories, evidential grading, consequence-first explanation, and observation-to-implication progression support a structured evaluative register.
Opposing concerns, personal limitations, concessions, pointwise responses, compact summaries, and humorous asides create a recognizable dialogic disagreement register.
Forceful evaluations, immediate corrective reframing, purpose-bounded criticism, reader-facing distinctions, and numbered consequences form a tightly unified critical register.

Guiding questions, parallel categories, evidential grading, corrective reframing, reader-facing transitions, and numbered consequences are individually salient but imply a somewhat mixed evaluative rhythm.

C03's forceful thesis, corrective reframing, bounded criticism, and numbered consequences sharply differ from C01's neutral clarity conventions.
Guiding questions, parallel comparison, evidential maturity, and consequence-first explanation clearly distinguish C04 from C01's generic exposition.
C05's personal, pointwise disagreement with concessions and humorous asides supplies several cues absent from C01.
C06's high-commitment correction, reader-facing distinctions, bounded criticism, and numbered implications strongly separate it from C01.
C07's guiding questions, parallel categories, corrective reframing, evidential grading, and numbered consequences contrast broadly with C01.
C02 emphasizes cautious personal and evidential positioning, while C03 emphasizes forceful correction, concession, bounded criticism, and consequences.
They share parallel categories, evidential grading, and observation-to-implication movement; personal opposing-concern framing versus guiding questions provides a reliable distinction.
Both use opposing concerns and personal stance, but C05 adds concessions, humor, summaries, and pointwise responses while C02 stresses evidential progression.
C02's cautious personal and evidence-calibrated framing contrasts with C06's forceful corrective thesis, purpose limitation, and numbered consequences.
They share parallel categorization and evidential grading, but C02 uses personal opposing concerns while C07 uses guiding questions, reframing, and numbered consequences.
C03's forceful rebuttal and bounded concession contrast with C04's question-led, evidence-graded comparative evaluation.
Despite shared concession, C03 uses corrective high-commitment criticism while C05 uses personal dual-concern framing, humor, summaries, and pointwise replies.
Both share high-commitment evaluation, corrective reframing, purpose-bounded criticism, and numbered consequences; concession versus reader-facing transition is narrow.
Both use reframing and numbered consequences, but C03 adds forceful bounded rebuttal while C07 adds guiding questions, parallel categories, and evidential grading.
C04's question-led evidence framework differs across several cues from C05's personal, concessive, humorous, pointwise disagreement.
C04 favors exploratory questions, category comparison, and evidence grading; C06 favors forceful correction, reader flags, bounded criticism, and consequences.
They share guiding questions, parallel categories, and evidential grading; C04's explanatory progression differs from C07's corrective reframing and numbered consequences.
C05's personal dual-concern dialogue, concession, humor, and pointwise replies contrast with C06's compact forceful correction and bounded implications.
C05 centers personal, concessive, lightly humorous disagreement; C07 centers guiding questions, comparative categories, evidence grading, and corrective progression.
They share reframing, reader-facing transitions, and numbered consequences, but forceful purpose-bounded criticism differs from questions, categories, and evidential grading.

method_limitations: Scores use only the listed feature descriptions, layers, and salience weights; no prose samples were available.
Feature counts differ slightly across cards, and the integer scale requires judgment about how overlapping cues combine.
